flights.title: Redesign a landing page hero and open it as a PR
flights.prompt: Redesign the hero section of the site in this repository so the call to action is visible before scrolling on a laptop. Use the copy agent for the wording and the layout agent for the structure, then have the code agent make the change, run the build and open a pull request.

flights.title: Research three competitors and draft a positioning brief
flights.prompt: Research these three competitors and draft a positioning brief for a small competitor-tracking SaaS: Crayon, Klue and Kompyte. Use one research agent per company, then have the writer produce the brief and file it.
